issues: '백업이 실패한 경우' was shortened to '실패하면', which drops the subject, so the reader cannot tell whether the backup failing or the check failing stops the deployment.
The subject '백업이' is dropped from '실패한 경우', so '실패하면' could also mean that the check itself failed, not only that the backup failed.
The subject 백업 was dropped from '백업이 실패한 경우에는', so '실패하면' could mean either the backup failing or the check failing.
